title: When behaviour must stay interpretable, speak in frozen classified tokens, not free prose
summary: The safety property of constrained model output is that it is semantically frozen and replayable: the model selects from a fixed catalog, an authoritative classifier accepts only exact known tokens, and unknown or invalid items are discarded rather than guessed. This keeps the live actor's intent interpretable and auditable.
evidence_note: HardWorld table-talk is deliberately NOT free text. PokerTableTalkLibrarian performs exact token classification of a frozen dictionary; the live AI mouth accepts only ACTION/AMOUNT/TALK/TALK_TARGET/SOCIAL_EVIDENCE machine lines and unknown/free-form tokens and invalid targets are discarded.
invariants: Model-free-form output only where the system truly tolerates it; where effect must be auditable, constrain to the catalog.
The classifier, not the model, remains authoritative for phrase, class, pressure and provocation deltas.
Reject (do not silently correct) an unknown token; a hallucinated or stale claim is retained as evidence of what was claimed and marked invalid.
A detached model seat cannot emit a phrase from the same decision the unavailable fallback never truly made.
